semiconductor_relevance: High — Trusval Technology specializes in facility system integration solutions specifically tailored for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Trusval Technology Co., Ltd. provides comprehensive facility system integration solutions for the semiconductor sector, focusing on high-purity supply systems and project engineering management. Their services encompass design, manufacturing, construction, and commissioning of semiconductor facility systems, ensuring efficient and sustainable operations.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Trusval has established itself as a leading partner in facility engineering and on-site project services in Taiwan.
regional_presence.United States: The company operates in the United States, leveraging global partners for turnkey solutions.
